answers.enterprise_value_unavailable_reason: Enterprise value depends on calculation-ready net_debt; market cap can be ready while EV is EV_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
answers.net_debt_unavailable_reason: short_term_debt remains REVIEW_REQUIRED when only a current-portion component is available instead of a complete current debt total.
answers.why_asml_d_and_a_was_not_calculation_rea: ASML current D&A uses us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization. That standard concept includes depletion in the taxonomy label and is therefore not generically safe for the internal D&A definition without semantic review.
